purpose: Independent design concept; not official business website; no real bookings or message sending.

imagery.hero_car: Procedural Three.js geometry, paint, glass, wheels and lights written in car-scene.js; no raster image or imported vehicle model.
imagery.water: Original layered SVG curves, reflections and droplets, reshaped by scroll progress in water-scenes.js.
imagery.secondary_cars: The wash ritual uses inline SVG. The playable wash car, wheel details, dirt, foam and hose are drawn procedurally on Canvas in wash-game.js; no imported image or video.
imagery.legacy_asset: The earlier AI-generated assets/hero-car.webp is retained as an unused historical asset and is not referenced or loaded by the page.

limitations: Published contacts reconfirmed; answerability and delivery not tested.
Current prices and guarantees intentionally omitted.
No claims about staff, ratings, years in business or actual customer work.
